evidence.detail: get_font_paths() returns hardcoded local paths with no existence check or download logic

Update fonts maintenance task to generate an actual woff2 file — added all font TTFs to git via LFS in March 2025; commit message notes that git lfs pull is required to get actual binaries instead of pointer files
All 10 font files are now git-tracked (via LFS): NotoEmoji, NotoSansHistorical, NotoSansJP, NotoSansLiving, NotoSansSC, NotoSansSymbols, NotoSansSymbols2, Segoe UI Symbol, Symbola, main-text

triage.notes: The problem landscape changed when fonts were committed via LFS (07b63480, March 2025). The 'not found' failure now occurs when git-lfs is not installed or git lfs pull hasn't been run, not when the repo is missing the fonts entirely. The fix should detect LFS pointer files (< 300 bytes containing 'git-lfs') and emit a clear error suggesting 'git lfs pull', rather than trying to download fonts from upstream sources — though auto-downloading Noto/Symbola from known URLs is also feasible if desired. Segoe UI Symbol cannot be freely downloaded programmatically.
